title: Pocket notes — go-live checks & PRD edits (EOD)
content:
2025-04-28 — pocket notes / end-of-day dump

Quick context: prepping the hosted API 2.1 launch (soft rollout). This doc is my fast scratchpad for PRD edits, stakeholder asks, and the go-live ToDos I don't want to lose. Not polished — just timestamped actions and unresolved questions.

MORNING PLAN (before standup)
- Finish PRD section: 'fallback routing' wording (clarify: fallback to compatible model family, not exact model).
- Confirm rollout window with infra: 10:00–12:00 UTC preference (low traffic).
- Draft message for #platform-ops about canary observability hooks.

STANDUP NOTES 9:30
- SRE (Daniel): autoscale policy tests green, one flaky metric in GPU OOM alerting. Need to adjust threshold to 0.92.
- Infra (Elena): capacity ok for canary at 50rps, 95th latency baseline measured.
- Docs (Me): PRD edits to example prompts + update behavior doc for streaming edge-case.

PRD EDITS TODO (quick list)
- [ ] Rephrase "automatic fallback" -> "policy-driven fallback" (calls out cost-tier and latency rules).
- [ ] Add small diagram for routing policy precedence (latency > cost > region) — simple ascii ok for now.
- [ ] Add 'Known limitations' bullet about embeddings consistency when quantized models used.
- [ ] Include short recovery playbook snippet: detect spike -> throttle non-critical routes -> roll back model variant.
- [x] Update version table (v2.1) with release date and migration notes.

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (who I need replies from)
- Legal (R. Singh): confirm data retention language for hosted API logs by EOD tomorrow.
- Sales Ops (Priya): need the revised pricing blurb for the launch page — ask for 2 variants (PLG-friendly + enterprise).
- Security (Anika): verify KMS integration log format; I left one open question in Confluence.

LAUNCH / CANARY CHECKLIST (for today)
- Pre-launch
  - [x] Smoke test the new streaming endpoint locally (pass).
  - [x] Canary config created in infra (50rps).
  - [ ] Healthcheck hook added to load balancer (waiting on infra patch).
  - [x] Grafana dashboard copied and annotated for v2.1 metrics.
  - [ ] Incident channel created (#incident-api-v2.1) — need final perms.

- During canary
  - monitor: token per-second, 95th latency, error budget burn rate, GPU mem usage
  - validate: sample outputs for function-calling and streaming truncated responses
  - run quick smoke-sampler script (samples from prod traffic, 10k requests) -> script location: /scripts/canary-smoke.sh (ask SRE for exec rights)

- Post-canary
  - gather: evaluation metrics, 5 sample transcripts, billing estimation from Optimize tool
  - decision: proceed to 2% rollout or rollback if >2x error budget burn in 30m

BLOCKERS / RISKS
- Alert flakiness: one noisy OOM alert could hide real regressions. Action: Daniel to tune threshold and add runbook snippet by 12:00 UTC.
- Permission gap: incident channel not yet open to all oncall members. Action: Elena to add devops and pm to channel.
- Docs gap: example showing function-calls with streaming is ambiguous. I need to add explicit example and ask SDK team to verify.

QUICK DECISIONS MADE (to capture)
- Use 50rps canary for 30 minutes then evaluate metrics (agreed with SRE).
- Fallback policy will prefer lower-cost model only when latency delta < 150ms.

MEETING NOTES — 13:00 sync with Sales Ops
- Priya wants a short 2-line value prop for hosted API sticky to marketing — I gave: "Predictable inference, lower unit cost by caching & batching optimizations — same API across private and hosted."
- Sales requests: embargoed pricing for pilot customers; create alias pricing doc for pilots.

EOD ACTIONS (my list)
- [ ] Reword PRD fallback section and push new draft to Confluence (link: CONFLUENCE-1234).
- [ ] Ping Legal re: retention (CONFLUENCE-987 comment).
- [ ] Remind Elena about LB healthcheck fix first thing tomorrow.
- [x] Upload canary dashboard screenshots to the launch folder.
- [ ] Draft short postmortem template for potential issues during rollout.

NOTES TO SELF / random thoughts
- Consider adding a small FAQ for internal teams: "When do we use Dedicated vs Hosted?" Short bullets could reduce repeated Slack questions.
- Follow up with SDK owner about streaming SDK example — maybe pair for 30 min tomorrow.
- If we hit errors on quantized model path, fallback should prefer non-quantized variant even if cost is higher for the first 5 minutes (give time to warm caches).

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Can legal sign off on 90-day logs instead of 180-day without extra clause? (R. Singh)
- Who will own the post-launch customer outreach for pilot customers? (SalesOps or CS?)

SNAPSHOT: quick metric baseline (from Grafana at 09:15)
- 95th latency (baseline): 380ms
- Avg token/sec: 12.4
- Error rate (last 24h): 0.04%

If I don't look at this tomorrow morning: 1) re-run smoke script, 2) confirm LB healthcheck patch, 3) finalize PRD fallback wording.

— Maya
